steps: Preserve airport context, original audio/transcript, actor candidates, capture/channel, source interval, event time and receipt time.
Parse speech act separately: request, instruction, readback, report, cancellation or unknown. Never make a request into authorization.
Normalize identifiers against that airport inventory; preserve runway suffixes and double letters. Return unresolved or multiple candidates when ambiguous.
Resolve intersection candidates from surface membership; a label alone maps to a surface or named area, not a unique position.
Keep the ordered taxiway words and hold constraints even if a continuous route is unknown. Do not substitute a shortest path.
Require reviewed connected segments and explicit crossing/hold constraints before route use. v1 files are review drafts, so automatic routing stays disabled.
Maintain instructed, acknowledged, reported, observed and predicted state separately with evidence links and amendment/supersedes IDs.
Use independent timestamped motion inputs and reviewed metric geometry or a separate explicitly fictional map for numerical prediction. Never measure PDF label locations as vehicle positions.
unknown_policy: null plus reason; never zero, guessed geometry, invented velocity or unspoken authorization

required: Metric geometry and declared CRS or explicitly fictional frame
Clock alignment, motion model and uncertainty assumptions
